status: Frozen before physiological payload acquisition or baseline fitting
bilateral_policy: Preserve individual neuron labels and side; class coverage is a separate metadata gate. No silent left/right averaging or class-to-individual join.
normalisation: Original exported fluorescence with provenance review, not whole-recording z-scores. Learned scaling on training animals only.
split_rule: SHA256(seed_tag|animal_id) ascending; first 15 train, next 6 validation, last 6 test. Fixed from the public 27-recording manifest before payload QC. Do not move excluded animals between splits.
diagnostic_selection: Predefined circuit; no replacement with stronger-performing neurons after outcome inspection. Training-only coverage selection within it; missing states masked.
diagnostic_evaluation: Nested animal-held-out diagnostics inside the training 15 only; validation six and final-test six untouched by fitting/parameter selection in this phase.
behaviour_primary: Mean signed forward velocity 1-3 seconds after independently calibrated near-boundary entry; inputs available at or before entry only.
behaviour_secondary: Reversal initiation within 3 seconds; censor incomplete target windows and record class balance.
evaluation: Equal animal weights, matched causal information and masks; whole-animal uncertainty. No cells/time points as independent replicates.
future_biological_validation: >=5% lower held-out MSE versus strong intrinsic and appropriate network/null comparators, with animal-level uncertainty excluding zero and robust mask/lag tests. Readiness GO alone is not this validation.
prohibited_now: inferring gap junctions from proximity or correlation
